I am **Glory Kellogg**, an Applied Mathematics Honors student at the Illinois Institute of Technology pursuing a minor in Computer Science.

I'm drawn to the mathematical undercurrents of the natural world. I like building models that bring those hidden structures into view.

Lately, I’ve been wondering how butterfly wings form their patterns and why some networks become unequal.

Read my [curriculum vitae](curriculum-vitae.qmd), or [send me an email](mailto:gloryekellogg@gmail.com).
